description: Utility functions and constants for data formatting, option handling, OS detection, and clipboard data preparation in the Superset frontend project.

methods.name: storeQuery
methods.description: Sends a query object to the server to store it and returns a URL with the stored query ID.

methods.name: optionLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for a given option value, handling special cases.

methods.name: optionValue
methods.description: Returns the option value or a null string placeholder.

methods.name: optionFromValue
methods.description: Creates an OptionItem object from a value, with label and value.

methods.name: prepareCopyToClipboardTabularData
methods.description: Converts tabular data into a tab-separated string suitable for copying.

methods.name: applyFormattingToTabularData
methods.description: Applies date/time formatting to specified columns in tabular data.

methods.name: detectOS
methods.description: Detects the user's operating system based on browser information.

methods.name: isSafari
methods.description: Detects if the browser is Safari.
